description: Hamiltonian-Reservoir Replica Exchange and Machine Learning Potentials for Computational Organic Chemistry is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Materials Cloud. This work combines a machine learning potential energy function with a modular enhanced sampling scheme to obtain statistically converged thermodynamical properties of flexible medium size organic molecules at high ab initio level. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Materials Cloud. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
